name: magic-ui-globe
title: Globe
description: A WebGL globe of grey dots that spins on its own and can be dragged to turn it; small orange markers sit on chosen cities and the continents sweep past.
use: A product wants to show worldwide reach behind a short headline.
avoid: A sized parent and WebGL are needed; without a graphics context it renders blank.
a11y: Drag to spin is pointer-only with no keyboard path, and the canvas has no text alternative describing the map. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A sphere of dense grey dots forming the continents, set on a black stage under a large white-to-grey headline. Round orange pins sit on the surface at scattered places and the rim glows faintly.
behaves: The globe turns steadily on its axis; dragging the sphere spins it and it eases to a stop on release. The cursor becomes a grab hand over it.
customise: A single config object sets colours, glow, the marker list, elevation and density; size and placement come from the parent and a class.
weight: heavy: A WebGL globe redrawn every animation frame in a requestAnimationFrame loop.
